verdict.rationale: BugSnag's docs show automatic grouping: events that share the same error class, file and line of the top in-project stack frame are grouped into one error (bugsnag-docs-1, bugsnag-docs-23), and the dashboard shows the grouping reason (bugsnag-docs-40). Nothing in the pack covers customizing grouping. The automation rules (bugsnag-docs-41) handle error assignment and the before-notify callbacks (bugsnag-docs-46) discard events, so neither is a grouping control. Missing for 10: documented custom grouping rules or fingerprint overrides, merge/unmerge of errors, independent corroboration that grouping works well at scale.
